description: Wave 6D-12 strictly read-only console probes (45 probes across 4 batches) covering spells, abilities, enchantments, base effects (SPEL/ENCH/ALCH/MGEF), AddSpell/RemoveSpell returns and pool placement, CIOS vs CastImmediate area spread, xNVSE vs JIP SPLO sync, GetActiveEffects bitmasks & TempCloneForm, JG/JIP MGEF AV/archetype/script/addiction/consume-sound edges, ShowOff live-effect stubs & GetSpellUsageNumEx; effect shaders (EFSH), Play/StopMagicShaderVisuals & Play/StopMagicEffectVisuals, HasEffectShader & GetPlayingEffectShaders, EFSH traits 0..46 & texture paths, ScriptEffectElapsedSeconds & sync start, Cast, IMAD/IMGS traits & animatable flag, ToggleHitEffects & HighlightBodyPartAlt; projectiles (PROJ), explosions (EXPL flags bit 0..32 & form slots 1..6), zero-damage PlaceAtMe explosion ref APIs, live projectile ref weapon/detonation/stuck & ShowOff overrides, mines, BPTD haspart/ragdoll/skeleton/traits/flags/VATS target, destruction stage debris/explosion, IPDS/IPCT & material property values; and GetIsPoison dynamic/non-ALCH edges, ApplyWeaponPoison invref/unarmed/keep, GetIsPoisoned, ShowOff limb crippling bitmasks/thresholds, 7-AV resistance stacking/caps, CIOS fire/poison mitigation, dual-flag Food+Medicine potency, negative SPECIAL floor, AMEF/AMMO clone mutations, and conditional ability / inactive effect visibility.
